page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 16 dedicated physical cores and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the weak category, with single-threaded gzip compression performing poorly. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels across Geekbench multi-core, stress-ng multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks remains within the average range, supporting stable multi-threaded operations.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation offers predictable execution for multi-threaded applications, though the lower single-core efficiency represents a tradeoff for workloads sensitive to individual thread latency. Appropriate use cases include static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, which all achieved average benchmark ratings. It can also handle light LLM inference tasks for smaller models, though performance degrades on larger models.
